subject.title: fix(codex): cap compaction override warning cache via createDedupeCache

question: Should the Codex ignored-compaction-override warning cache switch from process-lifetime warn-once to a 4096-entry LRU cap despite the related cache-cap PR being closed as unmeasured defensive churn?
rationale: The implementation shape is narrow, but accepting possible re-warnings after eviction depends on maintainer intent about this warning key space and lifecycle.

options.title: Require owner sign-off after repair
options.body: Keep the PR open only after the invalid trigger is fixed, production-path cap proof is added, and a Codex owner accepts the lifecycle tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the bounded cache tradeoff
options.body: Allow the 4096-entry cap once CI is green, accepting that very high-cardinality configurations can re-emit warnings after eviction.

options.title: Close as defensive churn
options.body: Apply the same rationale as the overlapping closed PR if no measured Codex growth path or owner lifecycle analysis is provided.

recommendation.title: Require owner sign-off after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open only after the invalid trigger is fixed, production-path cap proof is added, and a Codex owner accepts the lifecycle tradeoff.
